summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, reporting that BlackRock, Inc. crossed a threshold, holding 13.00% total voting rights (10.44% via shares, 2.56% via financial instruments) as of April 17, 2026. This is a routine major holdings notification under the UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules, not a special situation event. No acquisition or disposal of the company is involved; it is a passive stake disclosure. The filing has no deal terms, board recommendation, or corporate action implications.
